title: Build a shelter before the storm
description: You are alone on an open grass field. A tree cluster sits in the southwest, a stone outcrop in the northeast. A storm is coming at turn 30 — build a valid shelter and be inside it before the deadline.
goal: Build a valid shelter (≥ 3×3 floor, closed walls and roof, all placed blocks) and be inside it at or before turn 30.
notes: Agent starts at (16, 16, 1) — on top of the grass at the world's center. The grass cell below counts as solid ground.
Trees in southwest (roughly x:2-7, y:24-29) provide wood when broken. Each tree is a wood pillar.
Stone outcrop in northeast (roughly x:24-29, y:2-7) provides stone. Stone breaks slower than wood (MVP: all blocks break in 1 turn).
A minimum shelter takes 9 floor + 12 walls + 9 roof = 30 placed blocks, minus the 1 cell the agent occupies. Plan on ~24-30 blocks of gathering before completion.
Inventory cap is 20 (see rules.md). Gathering runs will need to be split.
